# raggame — Project Context

This file is the authoritative map of the repository for AI assistants. Read this instead of re-exploring the codebase.

## What this project is

**RAGame** is a 3D first-person detective game (Godot 4.6) where the player interrogates NPCs by typing free-form Spanish text. NPC replies are generated by a local LLM (Ollama) behind a FastAPI backend and streamed token-by-token into a chat UI. The current case ("Un crimen casi perfecto"): Mrs. Stevens was poisoned with cyanide in her whisky; suspects are Esteban, Juan and Pablo.

Despite the name, there is **no RAG/retrieval yet**: no embeddings, no vector store. NPCs are persona-prompted; clue detection is keyword matching in GDScript. "RAG" is the planned direction.

## Repo layout

```
backend/main.py          Entire backend: FastAPI + Ollama proxy
backend/requirements.txt Pinned deps (fastapi, uvicorn, requests, pydantic)
game/                    Godot 4.6 project ("RAGame", Forward Plus renderer, Jolt physics)
game/project.godot       Engine config: autoloads, input actions, main scene = campo.tscn
game/scenes/             All .tscn + gameplay scripts (player, npcs, locations, UI)
game/scripts/systems/    Autoload singletons (EventManager, InputManager) + pistas.md (empty placeholder)
game/data/events/        events.gd (empty placeholder, future clue catalog)
game/assets/             3D asset packs (PSX style) + story/design docs
assets/                  Empty
```

## Architecture / data flow

```
Player types text (DialogueUI LineEdit)
  → jugador.gd _on_text_submitted()
      1. EventManager.check_input(text)        # local keyword → clue activation
      2. nearby_npc.request_response(text)
          → npc.gd streams POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/dialogue_stream
              → backend/main.py builds messages [persona system + history + input]
                  → POST http://localhost:11434/api/chat (Ollama, qwen2.5:1.5b)
              ← streams plain-text chunks back
          ← emits response_chunk(text) ... response_completed
  ← DialogueUI appends chunks live into RichTextLabel history
```

## Backend (backend/main.py)

- `POST /dialogue_stream` — body `{npc_id, player_input, session_id="default"}`. Returns `StreamingResponse` of raw text chunks (not SSE). On unknown npc_id → 404.
- Personas hardcoded in `NPC_PERSONAS` dict (main.py:14): **Aldric** (blacksmith, leftover demo NPC), **Esteban**, **Juan**, **Criada**, **Pablo**, **Forense** (the real cast). Each prompt enforces: always Spanish, first person, 2–4 sentences (Juan shorter), never break character, admit ignorance instead of inventing.
- Conversation memory: `HISTORIES` defaultdict keyed `(session_id, npc_id)`, in RAM only, last `MAX_HISTORY = 20` messages sent to model. No persistence anywhere.
- Ollama call options: `num_predict: 200`, `temperature: 0.8`, `think: false`.
- Run: `uvicorn main:app --port 8000` (game hardcodes host 127.0.0.1 port 8000). Requires Oollama serving qwen2.5:1.5b on 11434.

## Game side

### Autoloads (project.godot [autoload])

- **EventManager** (`game/scripts/systems/event_manager.gd`) — global singleton holding discovered-clue state.
  - `activated_events: Dictionary`, signal `event_activated(event_id)`.
  - `activate_event(id)` idempotent; `has_event(id)`; `reset_events()`.
  - `check_input(text) -> bool`: lowercases input, substring-matches against `keyword_events` dict. Currently ONE clue: `"poliza de seguro"/"póliza de seguro"/"seguro de vida"/"póliza"` → `"poliza_de_seguro"` (event_manager.gd:74).
- **InputManager** (`game/scripts/systems/input_manager.gd`) — tracks last input device (keyboard/mouse vs joypad).
  - `using_controller: bool`, signal `device_changed(using_controller)`.
  - `action_glyph(action="interact") -> "[E]"` or `"(A)"` from InputMap; `cancel_glyph()` → `[Esc]`/`(B)`.

### Input map (project.godot)

| Action | Keyboard | Controller |
|---|---|---|
| `interact` | E | A (button 0) |
| `examine` | F | X (button 2) |
| `ui_cancel` | Esc | B |

Movement uses built-in `ui_left/right/up/down`. Physics engine: Jolt.

### Core scripts

- **jugador.gd** (scenes/jugador.gd) — `CharacterBody3D` player. Movement + walk anim ("mixamo_com"), rotates toward move dir. Freezes during dialogue (`in_dialogue`). Raycast every frame for group `examinable` (collision **mask 2**, max distance `EXAMINE_DISTANCE = 3.0`); with controller the ray goes through screen center, otherwise mouse position. Handles: open/close dialogue, examine object, route submitted text to EventManager + NPC streaming. Prompt priority: examinable > NPC > hidden.
- **npc.gd** (scenes/npc.gd) — `Node3D` base NPC. Exports `npc_id`, `npc_name`, `clothes_texture` (applied to first found MeshInstance3D material). Area3D `$InteractionArea` emits `player_entered_range/exited_range` when player enters group. `_ready()` also builds a `CollisionBody` StaticBody3D + CapsuleShape3D child (r=0.35, h=3.2 in local space — models are ~3.2u tall natively and instances scale it down), so the player physically collides with NPCs. Streaming via raw `HTTPClient` (poll-per-frame loop, reads chunks, emits `response_chunk`/`response_completed`). Guards with `is_streaming`. Backend constants at npc.gd:28-30.
- **DialogueUI.gd vs dialogue_ui.gd** (scenes/) — ⚠️ TWO versions exist:
  - `dialogue_ui.gd` (lowercase, 178 lines): NEWER — integrates InputManager, `show_prompt(target_name, verb="Hablar con", action="interact")` dynamic glyphs, updates prompt/placeholder on device change.
  - `DialogueUI.gd` (capitalized, 161 lines): OLDER — hardcoded `"[E] Hablar con "` text, `show_prompt(npc_name)` single arg.
  - **`DialogueUI.tscn` currently wires the OLD capitalized script**, but jugador.gd:200 calls `show_prompt(name, "Examinar", "examine")` (3 args) which only matches the new one — live signature mismatch to be aware of.
  - UI is built entirely in code inside `_ready()`: bottom-half panel, name label, scrollable BBCode RichTextLabel history, bottom LineEdit, floating prompt label. Player color #88ccff, NPC color #ffe080.
- **Examinable objects** pattern (see copa.gd): extends StaticBody3D, joins group `examinable`, exports `description` (@export_multiline) + `object_name`; methods `highlight()/unhighlight()` (emission overlay material), `get_description()`.
- **Map hub nodes** pattern (departamento.gd, comisaria.gd, laboratorio.gd, oficina.gd — all near-identical): StaticBody3D in group `nodo_mapa`, slow auto-rotation, same highlight/unhighlight, exports `location_name`, optionally `scene_path` (@export_file .tscn) + `get_scene_path()`. NOTE: these scripts serve double duty — they're used by the mapa_menu hub MODELS; the playable lab scene is laboratorio.tscn (a different thing).
- **mapa_menu.gd** (scenes/mapa_menu.gd) — 3D level-select hub: mouse raycast over `nodo_mapa` nodes highlights them; left click calls `change_scene_to_file(node.get_scene_path())`.

### Scenes

- `campo.tscn` — **main scene** (project.godot). Outdoor field with trees; instances jugador.tscn + npc.tscn + DialogueUI.tscn (dev/test playground).
- `mapa_menu.tscn` — hub with rotating building models wired to comisaria/departamento/laboratorio/oficina scripts.
- `Hall.tscn` — building hall; instances jugador + criada, esteban, juan.
- `laboratorio.tscn` — Pablo's forensic lab (playable): enclosed room w/ ceiling, two work tables with flasks/bottles, shelves, tall cabinet + counter on side walls, CRT desk workstation, breaker box. Props measured/scaled against real AABBs; flask.glb is 19m tall natively → use scale ≈0.04. All furniture has box colliders under a `Colliders` StaticBody3D node (scaled shared `BoxShape3D_unit`). Pablo instanced at scale 0.7.
- `dpto.tscn` — crime scene apartment; instances jugador + forense + victima.tscn + copa.tscn.
- `comisaria.tscn` — police station, player only. `elevador.tscn` — empty shell, no script/player.
- `npcs/*.tscn` (criada, esteban, forense, juan, pablo) — all share npc.gd, PSX character FBX models with per-NPC tint textures from assets/Characters_psx/Textures/tinted/.

### Groups used

- `player` (jugador), `npc` (npc.gd), `examinable` (interactable objects), `nodo_mapa` (hub location models).

## Story / design docs

`game/assets/crimen-casi-perfecto-scripts/`:
- `BS.-Un-crimen-casi-perfcto.-Arlt-.pdf` — source material (Roberto Arlt).
- `paso-a-paso-juego.md` — happy path + clue list per suspect (cyanide in whisky; Esteban = life insurance motive, Juan = grudge/sociopath ex-con, Pablo = lab tech with cyanide access; criada saw Mrs. Stevens make the drink).
- `guiones/*.md` — per-character interview scripts (criada, esteban, juan, pablo, quimico, tecnico_heladera, portero).

## Conventions

- Language: all comments, strings, prompts and docs in **Spanish (Rioplatense / voseo)** — "Vos", "tenés", "Escribí". Keep it that way.
- Godot: tabs indentation; UI constructed programmatically rather than in .tscn where dynamic; signals over polling; `@export` for designer-facing vars.
- Backend: minimal single-file FastAPI; pydantic models for request/response; no auth (local dev only).
- Comments in code are verbose teaching-style blocks (the author uses them to learn); match that style when editing existing files.

## Current state, gaps & known issues

1. No actual RAG: retrieval/embeddings/vector DB not implemented; personas are static prompts.
2. Keyword clue detection covers a single clue (`poliza_de_seguro`); comment in event_manager.gd says an LLM hook is planned. `data/events/events.gd` and `scripts/systems/pistas.md` are empty placeholders awaiting a proper clue catalog.
3. Duplicate DialogueUI scripts with a signature mismatch (scene uses old one; player expects new one) — see above.
4. Backend memory is RAM-only and unbounded per session; server restart wipes conversations. Session id is hardcoded `"default"` from npc.gd.
5. Aldric persona exists in backend but only used by generic npc.tscn in campo.tscn (dev playground).
6. Stray temp file `game/scenes/jugador.tscn102336247.tmp` should be deleted.
7. README.md contains only the title.
8. Examine raycast ignores areas (`collide_with_areas=false`), mask 2 only; objects must have collision on layer 2. NPC colliders are on layer 1, so they don't block examine rays.
9. `Hall.tscn` references nonexistent node type `AreaLight3D` — Godot drops that light node on load (scene still works, just missing that light). Should be replaced with OmniLight3D or similar.
10. Git history note: monorepo restructure moved everything under `game/` and `backend/`; recent commits added EventManager, keyword detection, controller support.
